meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑开源深度学习项目前,先把运行环境、权重与数据路径备好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个深度学习仓库却卡在环境与路径配置上
copy.tagline_en: Prepare environment, checkpoints, and data paths before running a deep learning repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a deep learning repo won't run and you're stuck on setup and paths

howto.what: 在你动手跑一个 README 齐全的深度学习仓库之前,它先给出保守的环境准备说明、候选 conda 命令、检查点与数据集的路径方案和来源线索,并列出还没解决的依赖或资产风险。
howto.when: 在仓库接手确认了可复现目标、且需要在运行命令前建环境或准备资产路径时接管。若仓库已自带可直接运行的环境,或只是扫描、汇报结果,则不适用。

say.text: 帮我为这个仓库准备 conda 环境和资产路径方案
say.note: 输出候选命令与路径计划

say.text: 这个仓库依赖的检查点和数据集该放在哪?
say.note: 给出来源线索与未决风险

say.text: 把 README 的安装步骤转成保守的环境搭建说明

howto.what_en: Before any run on a README-documented repo, it produces conservative environment setup notes, candidate conda commands, an asset path plan, checkpoint and dataset source hints, and a list of unresolved dependency or asset risks.
howto.when_en: Takes over after repo intake confirms a reproduction target, when a conda environment or asset paths must be readied before commands run. Not for repos already runnable, scans, or reporting.

say_en.text: Prepare a conda env and asset path plan for this repo
say_en.note: Gives candidate commands and a path plan

say_en.text: Where should this repo's checkpoints and datasets live?
say_en.note: Returns source hints and open risks

say_en.text: Turn the README install steps into conservative setup notes
say_en.note: Plans only; leaves the repo untouched
